<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Get a site's interleaving policy"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/sites/{siteId}/policy"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the current policy of the site with its `version` (also as the
`ETag`). A site that never declared one is a 404 `policy-not-found`: it is
inert and issues no hints.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
